# Homework 1 — Simple & Multiple Linear Regression

## Question 1 — Alumni Giving Data

```{r}
alumni <- read.csv("~/Desktop/BANA 7052/alumni.csv")

Y  <- alumni$alumni_giving_rate
X1 <- alumni$percent_of_classes_under_20
X2 <- alumni$student_faculty_ratio
```

### Question 1a — Fit Model with X1 and X2

```{r}
model <- lm(Y ~ X1 + X2)
summary(model)
coef(model)
```

### Question 1b — Prediction at X1 = 50, X2 = 10

```{r}
pred <- predict(
  model,
  newdata = data.frame(X1 = 50, X2 = 10)
)
pred
```

### Question 1c — Coefficients Table

```{r}
summary(model)$coefficients
```

### Question 1d — F‑Statistic and p‑value

```{r}
summary(model)$fstatistic

F_stat <- summary(model)$fstatistic

pf(
  F_stat[1],
  F_stat[2],
  F_stat[3],
  lower.tail = FALSE
)
```

### Question 1e — R² and Adjusted R²

```{r}
summary(model)$r.squared
summary(model)$adj.r.squared

model_hw1 <- lm(Y ~ X1)
summary(model_hw1)$r.squared
summary(model_hw1)$adj.r.squared
```

### Question 1f — Correlations

```{r}
cor(X1, Y)
cor(X2, Y)
cor(X1, X2)

cor(X1, Y)^2
cor(X2, Y)^2
```

## Question 2 — Adding Private Indicator

```{r}
X3 <- alumni$private

model_2 <- lm(Y ~ X1 + X2 + X3)
summary(model_2)
coef(model_2)
```

### Question 2b — Interpretation of Private Dummy

```{r}
b0 <- coef(model_2)[1]
b1 <- coef(model_2)[2]
b2 <- coef(model_2)[3]
b3 <- coef(model_2)[4]

# For X3 = 0 (public)
b0
b1
b2

# For X3 = 1 (private)
b0 + b3
b1
b2
```

### Question 2c — Partial F‑Test

```{r}
anova(model, model_2)
```

## Question 3 — Simulation Study

### Question 3a — Generate Data

```{r}
set.seed(7052)

n <- 100
X_1 <- rnorm(n, mean = 2, sd = 0.1)
X_2 <- rnorm(n, mean = 0, sd = 0.4)
epsilon <- rnorm(n, mean = 0, sd = 0.5)
Y <- 10 + 5*X_1 - 2*X_2 + epsilon
```

### Question 3b — Fit Model

```{r}
model_3a <- lm(Y ~ X_1 + X_2)
summary(model_3a)
```

### Question 3c — Larger Noise

```{r}
n <- 100
X_1 <- rnorm(n, mean = 2, sd = 0.1)
X_2 <- rnorm(n, mean = 0, sd = 0.4)
epsilon <- rnorm(n, mean = 0, sd = 1)
Y <- 10 + 5*X_1 - 2*X_2 + epsilon

model_3b <- lm(Y ~ X_1 + X_2)
summary(model_3b)
```
